name: FNAL-E-0613
full_name: Fermilab Experiment E613, prompt-neutrino beam-dump experiment
summary: Fermilab E613 searched for prompt neutrinos from short-lived heavy-particle decays in a proton beam dump, probing charm production and nonstandard neutrino phenomena.
detection_principle: Dense dump material suppressed ordinary pion and kaon decays while short-lived charmed particles could decay promptly. Shielding removed charged backgrounds before a lead-scintillator calorimeter and muon spectrometer measured neutrino interactions.
